optConfig.description: Standard org-level opt-in or opt-out configuration. RepoOverride applies to all configuration.

action.description: Which action to take. Default log; other options include issue.

branchList.description: Comma-separated branch list to scan for dangerous workflows. Empty scans all branches. The string default will be replaced with the git default branch. Must use refs/remotes/origin/branch_name format.

optConfig.description: Standard repo-level opt-in or opt-out configuration.

action.description: Override for org-level action when present

branchList.description: Comma-separated branch list to scan for dangerous workflows. Empty scans all branches. The string default will be replaced with the git default branch. Must use refs/remotes/origin/branch_name format. Repo-level list is additive to org-level list.
